blocks.zh: Commentary | 教學解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 導讀：為何蒸汽是「灰色地帶」？
blocks.en: Introduction: Why Is Steam a "Gray Area"?

blocks.zh: 核心訊息
blocks.en: Key Message

blocks.zh: 製藥蒸汽是少數「缺乏明確法規」的關鍵公用系統之一。FDA 和 USP 對水系統有詳盡規範，但對蒸汽卻幾乎沒有最低標準。這導致業界普遍「寧可做過頭」，反而造成：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical steam is one of the few critical utilities with no clear regulatory requirements. FDA and USP give detailed rules for water systems, but almost no minimum standards for steam. As a result, industry tends to "over-do it to be safe", which causes:

blocks.zh: 成本增加 — 不必要的潔淨蒸汽產生器
blocks.en: Higher cost — unnecessary clean steam generators

blocks.zh: 系統複雜化 — 更多設備 = 更多故障點
blocks.en: More complex systems — more equipment means more points of failure

blocks.zh: 可靠性降低 — 過度設計反而增加維護負擔
blocks.en: Lower reliability — over-design adds to the maintenance burden

blocks.zh: 比喻：用大砲打蚊子
blocks.en: Analogy: Using a cannon to kill a mosquito

blocks.zh: 想像你的工廠只需要「乾淨的自來水」就能洗手，但因為不確定法規要求，你決定用「注射用水（WFI）」來洗。水質當然合格，但成本高出10倍，而且 WFI 系統更難維護。蒸汽也一樣 — 很多工廠在只需要 Utility Steam 的地方用了 Clean Steam。
blocks.en: Imagine your plant only needs "clean tap water" to wash hands, but because you are unsure of the regulatory requirement, you decide to wash with Water for Injection (WFI). The water quality is certainly acceptable, but it costs 10 times more and a WFI system is harder to maintain. Steam works the same way: many plants use Clean Steam where Utility Steam would be enough.

blocks.zh: 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Takeaway

blocks.zh: 本章的核心價值：提供一套基於風險的決策框架，讓你不再「猜測」該用什麼等級的蒸汽，而是根據產品接觸風險、製程需求來做出合理選擇。
blocks.en: The core value of this chapter is a risk-based decision framework. Instead of guessing which steam grade to use, you make a justified choice based on product contact risk and process needs.

blocks.zh: 法規環境解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Regulatory Landscape

blocks.zh: 關鍵發現：法規近乎空白
blocks.en: Key Finding: The Regulatory Gap

blocks.zh: 這是本章最重要的觀念之一：Clean Steam 幾乎沒有法規標準。具體來說：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important ideas in this chapter: there are almost no regulatory standards for Clean Steam. Specifically:

blocks.zh: FDA 沒有 Clean Steam 最低標準
blocks.en: FDA has no minimum standard for Clean Steam

blocks.zh: USP 沒有 Clean Steam 專論（monograph）
blocks.en: USP has no Clean Steam monograph

blocks.zh: 沒有規範建材、表面粗糙度、儀控等級
blocks.en: There are no requirements for materials of construction, surface roughness or instrumentation and control grade

blocks.zh: 唯一明確的要求：1976年 LVP cGMP — 禁止胺類/聯氨類揮發性添加劑
blocks.en: The only explicit requirement is the 1976 LVP cGMP, which prohibits volatile amine/hydrazine additives

blocks.zh: 誰負責？— 使用者自負
blocks.en: Who Is Responsible? The User

blocks.zh: 「The user has the ultimate responsibility」— 這句話在 GMP 世界裡份量很重。意思是：
blocks.en: "The user has the ultimate responsibility" carries real weight in the GMP world. It means:

blocks.zh: 法規不會告訴你「用哪種蒸汽」
blocks.en: The regulations will not tell you "which steam to use"

blocks.zh: 你必須自己評估風險、選擇合適等級
blocks.en: You must assess the risk yourself and select the appropriate grade

blocks.zh: 稽核時，你要能說明你的選擇邏輯（rationale）
blocks.en: In an inspection, you must be able to explain your selection logic (rationale)

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼後面的 Decision Tree（7.6節）如此重要。
blocks.en: This is why the Decision Tree (Section 7.6) later in the chapter is so important.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Culinary Steam 的陷阱
blocks.en: Analogy: The Culinary Steam Trap

blocks.zh: Culinary Steam 是「食品級蒸汽」— 聽起來很安全？但注意：食品容許的鍋爐添加劑（如某些胺類），在藥品製造中可能完全不可接受。這就像食品級的防腐劑不能直接加入注射液一樣。製藥標準永遠高於食品標準。
blocks.en: Culinary Steam is "food-grade steam", which sounds safe. But note that boiler additives permitted in food (such as certain amines) may be completely unacceptable in pharmaceutical manufacturing. It is like food-grade preservatives, which cannot simply be added to an injectable. Pharmaceutical standards are always higher than food standards.

blocks.zh: Quality vs. Purity — 最容易混淆的概念
blocks.en: Quality vs. Purity: The Most Commonly Confused Concept

blocks.zh: 比喻：瓶裝水 vs. 自來水
blocks.en: Analogy: Bottled water vs. tap water

blocks.zh: Quality 就像水的「溫度和壓力」— 你需要的是熱水，但水龍頭流出來的是溫的（不夠飽和）或太燙（過熱），都不好用。
blocks.en: Quality is like the "temperature and pressure" of the water. You need hot water, but if what comes out of the tap is lukewarm (not saturated enough) or scalding (superheated), neither is usable.

blocks.zh: Purity 就像水裡「含什麼成分」— 即使溫度壓力都對，但水裡有鐵鏽或化學藥劑，就不能用在產品上。
blocks.en: Purity is like "what is in" the water. Even if temperature and pressure are right, water containing rust or chemicals cannot be used on product.

blocks.zh: 兩者獨立但都重要：高 Quality 低 Purity 的蒸汽（乾但含雜質）不適合產品接觸；低 Quality 高 Purity 的蒸汽（濕但乾淨）滅菌效率差。
blocks.en: The two are independent, and both matter: steam with high Quality but low Purity (dry but contaminated) is unsuitable for product contact; steam with low Quality but high Purity (wet but clean) sterilizes poorly.

blocks.zh: EN 285 — 歐盟的領先標準
blocks.en: EN 285: The European Benchmark

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA/USP 沒有蒸汽品質標準，但歐盟 EN 285 規定了：
blocks.en: US FDA/USP have no steam quality standard, but the European EN 285 specifies:

blocks.zh: 乾度（Dryness）：≥ 0.95
blocks.en: Dryness: ≥ 0.95

blocks.zh: 過熱度（Superheat）：≤ 25°C
blocks.en: Superheat: ≤ 25°C

blocks.zh: 不凝結氣體（NCG）：≤ 3.5%（體積）
blocks.en: Non-condensable gases (NCG): ≤ 3.5% (by volume)

blocks.zh: 實務上，即使在美國工廠，EN 285 常被作為內部蒸汽品質標準使用。
blocks.en: In practice, even US plants often use EN 285 as their internal steam quality standard.

blocks.zh: 兩種蒸汽的比較
blocks.en: Comparing the Two Types of Steam

blocks.zh: 分類邏輯：看「來源」而非「品質」
blocks.en: Classification Logic: By Source, Not Quality

blocks.zh: 蒸汽分類很簡單 — 只看它從哪裡來：
blocks.en: Steam classification is simple: it depends only on where the steam comes from:

blocks.zh: Utility Steam = 從工廠公用鍋爐來（有添加劑）
blocks.en: Utility Steam = from the plant utility boiler (contains additives)

blocks.zh: Clean Steam = 從專用產生器來（無添加劑）
blocks.en: Clean Steam = from a dedicated generator (no additives)

blocks.zh: 這不是「好壞」之分，而是「用途」之分。很多場景下 Utility Steam 完全合格。
blocks.en: This is not a "good vs. bad" distinction but a distinction of "intended use". In many applications Utility Steam is perfectly acceptable.

blocks.zh: Utility Steam 的三大特徵
blocks.en: Three Characteristics of Utility Steam

blocks.zh: 化學添加劑 — 防垢防蝕，但含胺類/聯氨類
blocks.en: Chemical additives — they prevent scale and corrosion, but include amines/hydrazines

blocks.zh: 過熱（Superheat） — 高壓減壓後產生，對滅菌不利
blocks.en: Superheat — produced when high-pressure steam is let down, and detrimental to sterilization

blocks.zh: 高 pH — 9.5-10.5，保護碳鋼管路
blocks.en: High pH — 9.5-10.5, which protects carbon steel piping

blocks.zh: 過濾不等於純化
blocks.en: Filtration Is Not Purification

blocks.zh: 這是非常重要的觀念：Utility Steam 可以過濾去除顆粒物（particulate），但無法去除溶解物和揮發物（如胺類）。就像水的活性碳濾芯能擋住沙子，但擋不住溶解的氯。
blocks.en: This is a very important point: Utility Steam can be filtered to remove particulates, but filtration cannot remove dissolved and volatile substances (such as amines). It is like an activated carbon water filter that stops sand but not dissolved chlorine.

blocks.zh: 所以如果應用需要「無添加劑」的蒸汽，過濾 Utility Steam 是不夠的 — 必須使用 Clean Steam。
blocks.en: So if an application requires steam "without additives", filtering Utility Steam is not enough. You must use Clean Steam.

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽 — 為何滅菌時是壞事？
blocks.en: Superheated Steam: Why Is It Bad for Sterilization?

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽（Superheated Steam）溫度高於飽和溫度，行為更像「熱空氣」而非蒸汽。滅菌需要的是飽和蒸汽的潛熱（latent heat）釋放 — 蒸汽凝結在物體表面時放出大量熱能。過熱蒸汽不凝結，傳熱效率大幅下降。
blocks.en: Superheated steam is at a temperature above the saturation temperature and behaves more like "hot air" than steam. Sterilization relies on the release of the latent heat of saturated steam: when steam condenses on a surface it gives up a large amount of heat energy. Superheated steam does not condense, so heat transfer efficiency drops sharply.

blocks.zh: 就像用吹風機烘乾和用蒸氣熨斗燙衣服的差別 — 蒸氣熨斗效果更好，因為凝結釋放的熱量更集中。
blocks.en: It is like the difference between drying clothes with a hair dryer and pressing them with a steam iron. The steam iron works better because the heat released on condensation is more concentrated.

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 深入解析
blocks.en: Clean Steam in Depth

blocks.zh: 名稱混亂 — 業界痛點
blocks.en: Confusing Terminology: An Industry Pain Point

blocks.zh: Clean Steam、Pure Steam、Pyrogen Free Steam、WFI Steam... 同一件事至少有5種叫法，而且沒有任何一個有標準定義。這在跨國稽核或設備採購時經常造成誤解。
blocks.en: Clean Steam, Pure Steam, Pyrogen Free Steam, WFI Steam... there are at least five names for the same thing, and none of them has a standard definition. This often causes misunderstandings in multinational audits and equipment purchasing.

blocks.zh: ISPE 的建議：統一使用 "Clean Steam" 一詞。在你的 SOP 和 URS 中也應該明確定義你用的術語。
blocks.en: ISPE recommendation: use the term "Clean Steam" consistently. You should also define the terms you use clearly in your SOPs and URS.

blocks.zh: 低 pH 的隱藏風險
blocks.en: The Hidden Risk of Low pH

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 凝結水沒有緩衝劑，pH 可能偏低（接近純水的 ~5.5-6.5）。這代表：
blocks.en: Clean Steam condensate has no buffering agents, so its pH may be low (close to that of pure water, ~5.5-6.5). This means:

blocks.zh: 管路必須用耐蝕材質（316L 不鏽鋼）
blocks.en: Piping must be made of corrosion-resistant material (316L stainless steel)

blocks.zh: 碳鋼管路會被快速腐蝕
blocks.en: Carbon steel piping would corrode quickly

blocks.zh: 這也是 Clean Steam 系統成本較高的原因之一
blocks.en: This is one reason Clean Steam systems cost more

blocks.zh: 業界實務 — 過度保守的代價
blocks.en: Industry Practice: The Cost of Over-Conservatism

blocks.zh: 滅菌蒸汽純度原則
blocks.en: Principle of Sterilizing Steam Purity

blocks.zh: 核心規則很簡單：蒸汽（或其凝結水）接觸產品時，純度應等同於該產品可接受的最終淋洗水純度。
blocks.en: The core rule is simple: when steam (or its condensate) contacts product, its purity should equal that of the final rinse water acceptable for that product.

blocks.zh: 例如：滅菌注射劑設備 → 凝結水應等同 WFI 品質。非無菌 API 中間體 → 可能 PW 品質就足夠。
blocks.en: For example: equipment for sterile injectables, where the condensate should be equivalent to WFI quality; non-sterile API intermediates, where PW quality may be sufficient.

blocks.zh: 滅菌蒸汽的三大敵人
blocks.en: Three Enemies of Sterilizing Steam

blocks.zh: 含水（Wet Steam） → 造成「濕包（damp loads）」→ 滅菌失敗
blocks.en: Moisture (Wet Steam) → causes "damp loads" → sterilization failure

blocks.zh: 過熱（Superheat） → 傳熱效率差 → 溫度到了但殺不死菌
blocks.en: Superheat → poor heat transfer → the temperature is reached but microorganisms are not killed

blocks.zh: 不凝結氣體（NCG） → 形成氣囊（air pockets）→ 蒸汽無法到達死角
blocks.en: Non-condensable gases (NCG) → form air pockets → steam cannot reach dead spots

blocks.zh: 這三者影響的是蒸汽「Quality」而非「Purity」，但都會導致滅菌失敗。
blocks.en: These three affect steam "Quality" rather than "Purity", but all can lead to sterilization failure.

blocks.zh: 加濕蒸汽：風險取決於「開放性」
blocks.en: Humidification Steam: Risk Depends on "Openness"

blocks.zh: 想像一下：
blocks.en: Consider:

blocks.zh: 辦公室空調加濕 → Utility Steam 完全OK（蒸汽不接觸產品）
blocks.en: Office air-conditioning humidification → Utility Steam is completely fine (steam does not contact product)

blocks.zh: 一般潔淨室加濕 → 需要評估（蒸汽進入空氣，但有 HEPA 過濾）
blocks.en: General cleanroom humidification → needs assessment (steam enters the air, but HEPA filtration is in place)

blocks.zh: 無菌充填室加濕 → 必須謹慎評估（開放製程，蒸汽可能接觸產品）
blocks.en: Sterile filling room humidification → must be assessed carefully (open process, steam may contact product)

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷：蒸汽中的雜質經稀釋後，是否會顯著影響產品品質？
blocks.en: The key judgment: after dilution, would the impurities in the steam significantly affect product quality?

blocks.zh: 常見浪費：用 WFI 產 Clean Steam
blocks.en: A Common Waste: Making Clean Steam from WFI

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出這是「overprocessing, wasteful and unnecessary」。Clean Steam Generator 本身就是蒸餾器 — 它能去除雜質。用 WFI 作為進水等於「蒸餾兩次」，毫無必要。
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly calls this "overprocessing, wasteful and unnecessary". A Clean Steam Generator is itself a still, and it removes impurities. Using WFI as feed water amounts to "distilling twice", which serves no purpose.

blocks.zh: 唯一例外：蒸汽需求量極小時，專用前處理系統的成本可能超過直接使用 WFI。
blocks.en: The only exception: when steam demand is very small, the cost of a dedicated pretreatment system may exceed the cost of simply using WFI.

blocks.zh: Table 7-1 解讀：哪些地方可以省？
blocks.en: Interpreting Table 7-1: Where Can You Save?

blocks.zh: Baseline vs. Common Practice — 差異很大
blocks.en: Baseline vs. Common Practice: A Big Difference

blocks.zh: 這張表揭示了一個重要事實：業界「常見做法」往往超過「基準要求」。
blocks.en: This table reveals an important fact: industry "common practice" often exceeds the "baseline requirement".

blocks.zh: Baseline = 合規所需的最低標準
blocks.en: Baseline = the minimum standard needed for compliance

blocks.zh: Common Practice = 業界普遍做法（常因保守而過度）
blocks.en: Common Practice = what industry generally does (often over-conservative)

blocks.zh: 可以省錢的三個場景
blocks.en: Three Scenarios Where You Can Save Money

blocks.zh: API 非關鍵步驟 — Utility Steam 就夠（後續步驟會去除雜質）
blocks.en: Non-critical API steps — Utility Steam is enough (later steps remove impurities)

blocks.zh: USP 水系統滅菌 — 可用 Utility Steam + 熱 USP 水沖洗 + 廢水測試
blocks.en: Sterilization of USP water systems — Utility Steam can be used, followed by a hot USP water rinse and effluent testing

blocks.zh: 非關鍵 HVAC 加濕 — Utility Steam 完全可接受
blocks.en: Non-critical HVAC humidification — Utility Steam is perfectly acceptable

blocks.zh: 這三個場景如果都用 SCSG，每年多花的錢可能數十萬美元。
blocks.en: If a stainless steel clean steam generator (SCSG) were used in all three scenarios, the extra cost could be hundreds of thousands of US dollars a year.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有以下蒸汽使用點，哪些需要 Clean Steam？
blocks.en: Your plant has the following steam use points. Which need Clean Steam?

blocks.zh: 無菌充填線 Autoclave 滅菌
blocks.en: Autoclave sterilization on the aseptic filling line

blocks.zh: CIP 系統的 SIP 滅菌
blocks.en: SIP sterilization of the CIP system

blocks.zh: 辦公區空調加濕
blocks.en: Office-area air-conditioning humidification

blocks.zh: API 反應槽加熱（夾套間接加熱）
blocks.en: API reactor heating (indirect heating via jacket)

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝室空調加濕
blocks.en: Aseptic filling room air-conditioning humidification

blocks.zh: 提示：思考蒸汽是否「直接或間接接觸產品」以及「後續是否有去除雜質的步驟」。
blocks.en: Hint: consider whether the steam "directly or indirectly contacts product" and whether "a later step removes impurities".

blocks.zh: 系統規劃方法論
blocks.en: System Planning Methodology

blocks.zh: 四大規劃邊界
blocks.en: The Four Planning Boundaries

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出的系統規劃是一個迭代循環，包含四個相互關聯的邊界：
blocks.en: The system planning approach proposed by ISPE is an iterative cycle of four interrelated boundaries:

blocks.zh: Steam Requirements（蒸汽需求） — 列出所有使用點和應用
blocks.en: Steam Requirements — list all use points and applications

blocks.zh: System Design（系統設計） — 選擇產生方式
blocks.en: System Design — select the method of generation

blocks.zh: Use Point Criteria（使用點標準） — 定義交付規格
blocks.en: Use Point Criteria — define the delivery specification

blocks.zh: Distribution System（輸送系統） — 管路設計
blocks.en: Distribution System — piping design

blocks.zh: 這四個步驟不是線性的 — 每一步的結果都會回饋影響其他步驟，需要反覆迭代。
blocks.en: These four steps are not linear. The result of each step feeds back to influence the others, so they must be iterated.

blocks.zh: 比喻：規劃蒸汽系統就像規劃自來水系統
blocks.en: Analogy: Planning a steam system is like planning a water supply system

blocks.zh: 想像你要為一棟新大樓設計供水系統：
blocks.en: Imagine designing the water supply for a new building:

blocks.zh: 需求：哪些樓層需要飲用水？哪些只需要沖馬桶？
blocks.en: Requirements: which floors need drinking water? Which only need water for flushing toilets?

blocks.zh: 設計：需要幾個水塔？要不要裝淨水器？
blocks.en: Design: how many water towers are needed? Should water purifiers be installed?

blocks.zh: 使用點：每個水龍頭需要多少流量和壓力？
blocks.en: Use points: how much flow and pressure does each tap need?

blocks.zh: 輸送：管路怎麼走？要不要保溫？
blocks.en: Distribution: how should the piping be routed? Does it need insulation?

blocks.zh: 蒸汽系統規劃邏輯完全相同，只是介質從水變成蒸汽。
blocks.en: Steam system planning follows exactly the same logic, except the medium changes from water to steam.

blocks.zh: 設計智慧：用「範圍」而非「定值」
blocks.en: Design Wisdom: Use "Ranges" Rather Than "Fixed Values"

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調：「indicate ranges of acceptability, rather than a specific value」。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically stresses: "indicate ranges of acceptability, rather than a specific value".

blocks.zh: 例如：不要寫「壓力 3.0 bar」，要寫「壓力 2.5-3.5 bar」。範圍給設計留有餘裕，避免因微小偏差就「不合規」。
blocks.en: For example: do not write "pressure 3.0 bar"; write "pressure 2.5-3.5 bar". A range leaves margin in the design and avoids "non-compliance" from a minor deviation.

blocks.zh: 經濟性考量
blocks.en: Economic Considerations

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 提到一個務實建議：如果工廠同時需要「有內毒素限制的 Clean Steam」和「無內毒素限制的 Clean Steam」，評估是否乾脆只產高等級。有時一套高等級系統比兩套不同等級系統更經濟。
blocks.en: Section 7.5.2 gives a pragmatic recommendation: if the plant needs both "Clean Steam with an endotoxin limit" and "Clean Steam without an endotoxin limit", consider producing only the higher grade. Sometimes one high-grade system is more economical than two systems of different grades.

blocks.zh: 使用點與輸送系統
blocks.en: Use Points and Distribution Systems

blocks.zh: Use Point Criteria — 需求分析三要素
blocks.en: Use Point Criteria: Three Elements of Demand Analysis

blocks.zh: 需求量分析：尖峰需求 vs. 平均需求。蒸汽系統必須能應對尖峰，但不能過度設計。用 histogram（直方圖）分析用量分布最有效。
blocks.en: Demand analysis: peak vs. average demand. The steam system must handle peak demand but must not be over-designed. A histogram is the most effective way to analyze the usage distribution.

blocks.zh: 壓力與流量：不同使用點需求不同（Autoclave 需要較高壓力，加濕需要較低壓力）。
blocks.en: Pressure and flow: different use points have different needs (autoclaves need higher pressure, humidification needs lower pressure).

blocks.zh: 品質與純度：使用點的 Quality 和 Purity 要求。
blocks.en: Quality and purity: the Quality and Purity requirements at the use point.

blocks.zh: 輸送系統的隱藏挑戰
blocks.en: Hidden Challenges of the Distribution System

blocks.zh: 蒸汽管路不是「裝了就好」。管路越長：
blocks.en: Steam piping is not "install and forget". The longer the piping:

blocks.zh: 熱損失越大 → 蒸汽凝結 → Quality 下降
blocks.en: The greater the heat loss → steam condenses → Quality declines

blocks.zh: 凝結水積累 → 需要足夠的疏水閥（steam trap）
blocks.en: Condensate accumulates → enough steam traps are needed

blocks.zh: 不凝結氣體累積 → 需要排氣點
blocks.en: Non-condensable gases accumulate → venting points are needed

blocks.zh: 管路傾斜 → 必須確保自然排水（natural drainage）
blocks.en: Pipe slope → natural drainage must be ensured

blocks.zh: 因此 ISPE 提醒：使用點的蒸汽品質不等於產生器出口的品質。
blocks.en: This is why ISPE reminds us: steam quality at the use point is not the same as quality at the generator outlet.

blocks.zh: 單等級 vs. 多等級策略
blocks.en: Single-Grade vs. Multi-Grade Strategy

blocks.zh: 就像工廠用水策略：
blocks.en: Like a plant water strategy:

blocks.zh: 小工廠（使用點少）→ 只產一種最高等級的 Clean Steam，全廠共用。簡單、好管理。
blocks.en: Small plant (few use points) → produce one type, the highest grade of Clean Steam, shared across the plant. Simple and easy to manage.

blocks.zh: 大工廠（使用點多、需求差異大）→ 分兩級：Clean Steam 給關鍵點，Utility Steam 給非關鍵點。省錢但系統更複雜。
blocks.en: Large plant (many use points, widely differing needs) → two grades: Clean Steam for critical points, Utility Steam for non-critical points. It saves money but the system is more complex.

blocks.zh: 決策關鍵：蒸汽消耗量和純度需求的差異程度。
blocks.en: The deciding factor: how much steam consumption and purity requirements differ across the plant.

blocks.zh: 設計思考題
blocks.en: Design Question

blocks.zh: 你的工廠蒸汽管路從 Clean Steam Generator 到最遠的 Autoclave 有 150 公尺。你觀察到 Autoclave 偶爾出現「濕包」問題。可能的原因和解決方案是什麼？
blocks.en: In your plant the steam piping runs 150 meters from the Clean Steam Generator to the farthest autoclave. You observe occasional "damp load" problems in the autoclave. What are the possible causes and solutions?

blocks.zh: 提示：考慮管路長度、保溫效果、疏水閥配置、管路傾斜度。
blocks.en: Hint: consider pipe length, insulation effectiveness, steam trap arrangement and pipe slope.

blocks.zh: 決策樹詳解 — 蒸汽選擇的核心工具
blocks.en: The Decision Tree in Detail: The Core Tool for Steam Selection

blocks.zh: 最常見的誤區
blocks.en: The Most Common Misconceptions

blocks.zh: 誤區1：「所有滅菌蒸汽都要 Clean Steam」→ 錯！發酵槽滅菌用 Utility Steam 就是 baseline。
blocks.en: Misconception 1: "All sterilizing steam must be Clean Steam" → Wrong! For fermenter sterilization, Utility Steam is the baseline.

blocks.zh: 誤區2：「Clean Steam 一定要用 WFI 產」→ 錯！Steam Generator 本身就能去除雜質，處理水（Treated Water）通常就足夠。
blocks.en: Misconception 2: "Clean Steam must be made from WFI" → Wrong! The steam generator itself removes impurities, and Treated Water is usually enough.

blocks.zh: 誤區3：「所有潔淨室加濕都要 Clean Steam」→ 錯！只有「開放製程」且雜質影響產品時才需要。
blocks.en: Misconception 3: "All cleanroom humidification needs Clean Steam" → Wrong! It is needed only for an "open process" where impurities affect the product.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：快速判斷法
blocks.en: Practical Application: A Quick Way to Decide

blocks.zh: 當有人問「這個點需要 Clean Steam 嗎？」，按以下順序回答：
blocks.en: When someone asks "does this point need Clean Steam?", answer in this order:

blocks.zh: 蒸汽碰到產品嗎？→ YES = Clean Steam
blocks.en: Does the steam touch the product? → YES = Clean Steam

blocks.zh: 蒸汽碰到「會碰產品的設備」嗎？→ YES = Clean Steam
blocks.en: Does the steam touch "equipment that will touch product"? → YES = Clean Steam

blocks.zh: 蒸汽進入「開放製程的空氣」嗎？→ 要評估
blocks.en: Does the steam enter "the air of an open process"? → needs assessment

blocks.zh: 以上都不是？→ Utility Steam 通常就夠
blocks.en: None of the above? → Utility Steam is usually enough

blocks.zh: 情境練習：Decision Tree 應用
blocks.en: Scenario Exercise: Applying the Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 判斷以下場景該用哪種蒸汽：
blocks.en: Decide which steam to use in each of the following scenarios:

blocks.zh: SIP 滅菌無菌充填線的 holding tank
blocks.en: SIP sterilization of a holding tank on the aseptic filling line

blocks.zh: API 合成反應中，蒸汽直接注入反應液
blocks.en: Steam injected directly into the reaction mixture in an API synthesis

blocks.zh: 配方區 HVAC 加濕（封閉製程）
blocks.en: HVAC humidification in the formulation area (closed process)

blocks.zh: WFI 儲槽的週期性 SIP
blocks.en: Periodic SIP of a WFI storage tank

blocks.zh: 包裝區加熱用蒸汽（夾套加熱）
blocks.en: Steam for heating in the packaging area (jacket heating)

blocks.zh: 參考答案：1. Clean Steam, 2. Clean Steam, 3. 需評估（封閉製程可能 Utility 即可）, 4. Clean Steam 或 Utility+WFI沖洗, 5. Utility Steam
blocks.en: Reference answers: 1. Clean Steam, 2. Clean Steam, 3. needs assessment (for a closed process, Utility Steam may be sufficient), 4. Clean Steam or Utility Steam + WFI rinse, 5. Utility Steam

blocks.zh: 決策邏輯總結
blocks.en: Summary of Decision Logic

blocks.zh: Decision Tree 的邏輯可以簡化為一個核心問題：蒸汽（或其凝結水）是否接觸產品？
blocks.en: The logic of the Decision Tree can be reduced to one core question: does the steam (or its condensate) contact product?

blocks.zh: Section Summary | 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 法規空白：FDA/USP 對 Clean Steam 沒有最低標準，使用者自負選擇責任。唯一明確禁令：LVP 相關蒸汽不得含揮發性添加劑（胺類/聯氨類）。
blocks.en: Regulatory gap: FDA/USP set no minimum standard for Clean Steam, and the user is responsible for the choice. The only explicit prohibition: steam related to LVPs must not contain volatile additives (amines/hydrazines).

blocks.zh: Quality vs. Purity：Quality = 飽和度/乾度（影響滅菌效率）；Purity = 化學/內毒素含量（影響產品安全）。兩者獨立且都重要。
blocks.en: Quality vs. Purity: Quality = saturation/dryness (affects sterilization efficiency); Purity = chemical/endotoxin content (affects product safety). The two are independent and both matter.

blocks.zh: 兩類蒸汽：Utility Steam（有添加劑、高 pH、可能過熱）vs. Clean Steam（無添加劑、低 pH、專用產生器）。分類依據是「來源」而非品質高低。
blocks.en: Two types of steam: Utility Steam (with additives, high pH, possibly superheated) vs. Clean Steam (no additives, low pH, dedicated generator). Classification is by "source", not by level of quality.

blocks.zh: 業界過度保守：常見做法包括「用 WFI 產 Clean Steam」和「非關鍵應用也用 SCSG」，造成不必要的成本和複雜性。
blocks.en: Industry over-conservatism: common practices include "making Clean Steam from WFI" and "using an SCSG even for non-critical applications", which cause unnecessary cost and complexity.

blocks.zh: 系統規劃四步驟：Steam Requirements → System Design → Use Point Criteria → Distribution System，迭代循環執行。
blocks.en: Four-step system planning: Steam Requirements → System Design → Use Point Criteria → Distribution System, carried out as an iterative cycle.

blocks.zh: Decision Tree 核心邏輯：蒸汽是否接觸產品？→ 是否滅菌產品設備？→ 是否加濕開放製程？→ 依序判斷蒸汽等級。
blocks.en: Core logic of the Decision Tree: does the steam contact product? → does it sterilize product equipment? → does it humidify an open process? → determine the steam grade in that order.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：用「範圍」而非「定值」規劃；小工廠可用單等級策略；輸送管路會降低蒸汽品質，需考慮保溫和疏水。
blocks.en: Practical advice: plan with "ranges" rather than "fixed values"; small plants can use a single-grade strategy; distribution piping degrades steam quality, so consider insulation and steam traps.
